evidence: ET INFO Insecure Proxy Discovery via AWS Instance Metadata Retrieval M1
details.rationale: Canh bao mo ta mot yeu cau HTTP GET den endpoint metadata nham phat hien proxy khong an toan (Insecure Proxy Discovery). Hanh vi nay dac trung cho viec do quet danh gia tinh trang bao mat va cau hinh yeu kem cua ung dung (T1595.002). Mac du vay, hanh vi nay cung mang dau hieu khai thac SSRF/Open Proxy (T1190) tren mot dich vu noi bo.
details.uncertainty: Khong the phan biet hoan toan giua do quet tham do cau hinh (T1595.002) va khai thac ung dung (T1190) chi qua mot phien HTTP don le, dong thoi cac ky thuat dac thu ve Cloud Discovery nam ngoai danh muc duoc cung cap.
